Name: Red Sea
ModernLocation: Red Sea, between Egypt and Arabia
Description: The sea God parted for Israel's escape from Egypt and closed over Pharaoh's army, also called the Sea of Reeds.
BiblicalSignificance: The Red Sea is the water of deliverance, where Israel walked dry-shod and sang the song of Moses.
KeyScriptures: Exodus 14:21; Exodus 15:1; Numbers 33:10; Exodus 15:4; 1 Kings 9:26; Acts 7:36; Hebrews 11:29
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
